newsitem.title: USA: TYPHOON WINNIE THREATENS MARIANA ISLANDS.
newsitem.headline: TYPHOON WINNIE THREATENS MARIANA ISLANDS.

text.p: Typhoon Winnie with 95 mph winds threatens the northern Mariana Islands in the Pacific Ocean, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.

Winnie, with 95 mph winds, is currently centred 500 miles east northeast of Guam, moving west at 10 mph. It is expected to intensify and move west northwestward across the northern Mariana Islands during the next 36 to 48 hours.
Top winds should be over 100 mph as the storm crosses the islands. Wind damage, storm surge coastal flooding, and flooding rains can be expected with this system.
